title: Sleep-EEG machine-learning brain age index shows accelerated aging in epilepsy
summary: In a case-control study, the sleep-based brain age index (BAI), a machine-learning biomarker of how overnight EEG deviates from age norms, was compared between age-matched controls without epilepsy and 138 patients with epilepsy. Mean BAI was -0.05 years in controls versus 5.02 years in epilepsy, and higher BAI was associated with lifetime seizure burden. The BAI model was trained earlier and not re-validated here, and the study is cross-sectional and single-center.
ai_technology: Machine-learning sleep-EEG brain age index (BAI) applied to patients and controls

evidence.tested: Comparison with independent age-matched controls using a pre-existing model.
evidence.unknown: Causality and whether BAI tracks clinical change over time; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Computes brain age index from sleep EEG
